description.value: On Top Bike Shop has been serving North Shore cyclists since 1996 from its location on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver. The shop offers a comprehensive range of bicycle repair services from basic tunes to complete overhauls and suspension rebuilds, and also services skis and snowboards in winter. It is a well-rooted presence in the North Shore riding community, experienced with all bicycle types including e-bikes.
